    Profile

    Kazahaya is a young lad who left his home in Wadatsumi to work abroad. He likes traveling, so whenever he arrives somewhere new, he enjoys exploring the hot springs and secluded areas. In contrast to his nimble body, he tends to act like a grandpa.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Male
    Height: 180cm
    Weight: 60kg
    Birthday: Feb 19
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Wind Goddess
    Likes: Red-bean soup
    Hobbies: Visiting hot springs
    Illust: さぶ
    CV: 西山宏太朗
